tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Private homes in Vancouver, Burnaby and West Vancouver, BC that are free for the dates, with the exact total (cleaning and 5% GST included, no service fee). Show each home's link; the guest can book on the page or ask you to book.

tools.name: book_stay
tools.description: Holds the home and returns a secure Stripe payment link. The booking is confirmed only when the guest pays on that page. Ask the guest for their full name and email first.
